title: Tipping Point
author: UncleLogic
rules:
Tipping Point is a variant Sudoku using Arrows and Killer Cages.

Sudoku:

Place the digits 1–9 in every row, column, and 3×3 box, with no repeats.

Arrows:

Digits along each arrow must sum to the digit in its attached circle.

Killer Cages:

Digits within each dashed cage must sum to the number shown in the top-left corner of the cage.

Digits may not repeat within a cage.

Play online:

Solve in SudokuPad

I hope you enjoy it!

More puzzles by me can be found at UncleLogic.com.
solutionCode: Enter the digits in Row 8 from left to right.
